test_title: PYST 26 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

Peter did not speak to __**no one**__ in the room.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. anyone .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence contains a double negative: "did not" and "no one." In standard English grammar, double n
